mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an equitable remedy and the grant of it depends on the discretion of the judge; while this discretion must be exercised both judicially and judiciously."
An Injunction is an equitable remedy and the grant of it depends on the discretion of the judge; while this discretion must be exercised both judicially and judiciously.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means therefore that any law enacted by the parliament overrides any form of law."
The supremacy of parliament means therefore that any law enacted by the parliament overrides any form of law.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a member of comity of nations."
Nigeria is a member of comity of nations.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means a place of standing; and it is a right to be exercised only if the application falls within the previews of section 6(6) of the 1979 Constitution of Nigeria."
LOCUS STANDI literally means a place of standing; and it is a right to be exercised only if the application falls within the previews of section 6(6) of the 1979 Constitution of Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Head of State, the Chief Executive of the Federation and also the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of the Federation."
The President is the Head of State, the Chief Executive of the Federation and also the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of the Federation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that all the ministers are collectively responsible to the elected parliament for the general policy of the administration."
Ministerial responsibility means that all the ministers are collectively responsible to the elected parliament for the general policy of the administration.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a right to be heard by any person in Court or other proceedings."
Locus Standi is a right to be heard by any person in Court or other proceedings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means a restraint on a person's personal liberty in order to make the person amenable to justice."
Arrest means a restraint on a person's personal liberty in order to make the person amenable to justice.
fib: ______ is an expression that is contained in many sections of the constitution.
Justice

______ is a borrowed relic of the English system of government which became operative as a result of the conflict between the crown and the parliament in England.
Parliamentary sovereignty
Parliamentary sovereignty is a borrowed relic of the English system of government which became operative as a result of the conflict between the crown and the parliament in England.
______ is concerned with the law regulating the affairs of an employee with that of the employer.
Constitutional Law
Constitutional Law is concerned with the law regulating the affairs of an employee with that of the employer.
______ is the third organ or arm of government.
Judiciary
The Judiciary is the third organ or arm of government.
______ is a constitutional right contained in chapter IV of the constitution.
Freedom
Freedom is a constitutional right contained in chapter IV of the constitution.
______ is the best means of developing a nation and on a personal level, it is the best way to developing an individual.
Education
Education is the best means of developing a nation and on a personal level, it is the best way to developing an individual.
______ is the Chief Justice of Nigeria.
Head of the Supreme Court
The Head of the Supreme Court is the Chief Justice of Nigeria.
